cat.intro: Browse categories and choose entire categories or individual lists. Nothing changes until you confirm.
cat.options.hint: Lists are downloaded and validated before they are enabled. LICENSE_UNKNOWN means the upstream license has not been verified; you can select the list and it will download when applied. NEEDS REVIEW and BROKEN mean the source is not yet technically usable. Selecting a checkbox stages a change; it takes effect only when confirmed.
